definitions.explanation: An informal, somewhat masculine word for lunch. Less polite than {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}.

examples.japanese: {昼飯|ひるめし}は{何|なに}にする？
examples.english: What are you having for lunch?

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}が{忙|いそが}しくて{昼飯|ひるめし}を{食|た}べ{損|そこ}ねた。
examples.english: I was so busy with work that I missed lunch.

notes:
An informal, somewhat rough word for lunch. Has a masculine tone and sounds blunt. Not appropriate in polite or formal situations.

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {昼|ひる} (midday) + {飯|めし} (meal, informal).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}: lunch — standard, neutral
- {昼食|ちゅうしょく}: lunch — formal, written
- ランチ: lunch — casual, modern

SAME REGISTER:
- {朝飯|あさめし}: breakfast (informal)
- {晩飯|ばんめし}: dinner (informal)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {昼飯|ひるめし}にする: to have lunch
- {昼飯|ひるめし}を{食|く}う: to eat lunch (very casual, uses {食|く}う instead of {食|た}べる)
